notes.title: A major update!
notes.content:
- Now there are two ships in the game that the player can control. The ships differ in the weapons that 
  can be used and the model of movement.
- One of the ships was completely recreated, now its design is more in line
  with the artistic style of the game.
- For an alternative version of the game, in which you can immediately select any of the funds, a separate 
  boss has been created, which may look different.
- New enemies have been added.
- Added new backgrounds where battles with enemies take place. Now out of 7.
- New music.
- A new start screen.

notes.title: A new spaceship
notes.content:
- Another spaceship is now available to players, with a new movement model! A completely new design, not like the one that was available at the time of release. In keeping with the new spaceship's directional orientation, enemies now appear from below as well, making passing more difficult.
- The new spaceship has a new arsenal of weapons for destroying enemies. 10 kinds of light projectiles, each with its own pattern of action, and 4 kinds of powerful means of defeating enemies.
- At the start of the game you can choose which spaceship you will use, old or new, for the game.
- Also immediately available alternative game mode, in which the generation of enemies is randomized. This variant of the game will continue without saving, with constant complication over time.
